text: I do not see it. Where is it? lol this is crazy the app is literally just frozen because its compiled now like 30 times in the last 5 minutes
resolution: The req_1865 toggle couldn't help because the app was too frozen to click it. Root cause: the auto-compile effect re-armed a bake on every (re)mount, and a hot reload re-mounts the cart — so an agent's rapid file edits = dozens of hot reloads = dozens of back-to-back 5-6s bakes = frozen editor. Fixed at the source with a mount guard (autoCompileArmedRef): the effect skips its FIRST run after each (re)mount (the hot-reload re-run with unchanged world data) and only arms the bake on SUBSEQUENT runs — a real worldRev/placements/previewWorld edit this session. Hot reloads no longer compile; actual edits still do; manual Compile unaffected. The persisted toggle (req_1865) stays as the explicit off switch (loader pane corner, above LOADER VIEW). TSX-only, hot-reloads. Committed 8e59816ae; pairs with req_1865 (0d736c625). One dev-host restart clears any in-flight storm; the guard prevents recurrence.
